title: Group14 Technologies
summary: Woodinville, Washington maker of silicon-carbon composite anode material for lithium-ion cells.
bodyHtml:
Group14 produces a silicon-carbon composite anode powder, SCC55, that is blended into conventional graphite anodes to increase capacity.

The company has built commercial-scale manufacturing and supply agreements with battery makers in Asia and Europe.

Why it matters

  • Silicon-carbon composite
  • Blend with graphite
  • Commercial-scale supply
